answer: A workable defence is requiring every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, tied to one verifiable identity thread: its past completed jobs, ratings and dispute history form a single reputation thread that cannot be split across copies. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real locked capital per copy, while a lone honest sparrow-like newcomer can still join cheaply by starting small and earning trust gradually, like a nebula condensing slowly into a star rather than appearing fully formed overnight.
